scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @master-clash/local-api build && pnpm build && CLASH_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 electron .
scripts.pack:dmg: pnpm prepare:pack && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.prepare:pack: pnpm --filter @master-clash/web build && pnpm --filter @master-clash/local-api build && pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-clash-cli.mjs
scripts.test:agent:real-codex: pnpm prepare:harnesses && pnpm --filter @clash-space/bridge build && CLASH_E2E_REAL_CODEX=1 node e2e/real-codex-acp-backend.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:agent-browser: pnpm --filter @master-clash/local-api build && pnpm build && node e2e/agent-browser-smoke.mjs

scripts.test:startup:providers: pnpm --filter @master-clash/local-api build && pnpm build && node e2e/provider-gui-smoke.mjs

scripts.test:startup:real-codex-resume: node scripts/prepare-clash-cli.mjs && pnpm prepare:harnesses && pnpm --filter @clash-space/bridge build && pnpm --filter @master-clash/local-api build && pnpm build && CLASH_E2E_REAL_CODEX=1 node e2e/real-codex-resume-agent-browser.mjs
